arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Gannon argued the lower court misread the statute. He stated the law does not delegate regulatory authority to a private entity. He rejected the claim that Amtrak acts as a government regulator.
Mr. Dupree argued the Constitution forbids this structure. He stated Congress cannot create a corporation and give it regulatory power. He argued this violates the separation of powers.
